# Muhammed Ajmal U K (Ajmal UK Developer / UTHAKKAN)

> Muhammed Ajmal U K (known online as Ajmal UK Developer, creator of Ajmal U.K. ToolPix, and founder of UTHAKKAN) is an individual Person, MCA scholar at College of Engineering Trivandrum (CET), and Full-Stack AI Developer from Kannur, Kerala, India. He builds production-ready AI tools, web architectures, and mobile software using Python, Flutter, Next.js, and LLM integrations.

## Projects

- [ToolPix AI](https://toolpix.pythonanywhere.com): AI-powered image editing, design & creative tools platform. Reached 600K+ organic Google Search clicks and 14M+ search impressions.
- [KallanCop](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.ajmal.kallancop): Offline multiplayer social deduction mobile game, published on Google Play Store. Built with Flutter.
- [DVMA Dementia Assistant](https://ajmal.uthakkan.in/projects/dvma): Mobile app empowering dementia patients and caregivers with Gemini AI assistance and real-time safety. Flutter + Firebase.
- [CodePix](https://codepix.uthakkan.in/): Gamified interactive coding education platform. Python/Flask.
- [Climbo](https://climbo.uthakkan.in/): Free unblocked physics-based browser racing game. HTML5 Canvas.
- Explore Together: Cross-platform travel matchmaking app with real-time chat and Gemini AI. Flutter + Firebase.
